headword: {床上浸水|ゆかうえしんすい}
gloss: above-floor flooding; flooding that rises above the floor level

definitions.gloss: above-floor flooding; flooding where water rises above the floor level of a building
definitions.explanation: A category of flood damage in Japanese disaster statistics in which floodwater rises above the floor of a building, inundating the living space itself. It is the more severe of the two official flood-damage categories, the other being {床下浸水|ゆかしたしんすい} (below-floor flooding).

examples.japanese: {家|いえ}が{床上浸水|ゆかうえしんすい}してしまった。
examples.english: Our house was flooded above floor level.

examples.japanese: {床上浸水|ゆかうえしんすい}の{被害|ひがい}を{受|う}けた{家屋|かおく}は{修復|しゅうふく}に{時間|じかん}がかかる。
examples.english: Houses that suffer above-floor flooding take time to repair.

examples.japanese: {豪雨|ごうう}の{影響|えいきょう}で、{川沿|かわぞ}いの{住宅|じゅうたく}が{広|ひろ}い{範囲|はんい}で{床上浸水|ゆかうえしんすい}した。
examples.english: Due to the heavy rain, homes along the river suffered above-floor flooding over a wide area.

examples.japanese: {床上浸水|ゆかうえしんすい}になった{場合|ばあい}、{畳|たたみ}や{家具|かぐ}、{家電|かでん}などの{多|おお}くが{使|つか}えなくなってしまうことが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: When above-floor flooding occurs, tatami, furniture, and home appliances often become unusable.

notes:
Composed of {床上|ゆかうえ} (above the floor) and {浸水|しんすい} (flooding). A set phrase used in official disaster classifications, news coverage, and insurance documentation.

USAGE:
Japanese disaster statistics officially separate house flooding into two categories: {床下浸水|ゆかしたしんすい} (water only below the floor) and {床上浸水|ゆかうえしんすい} (water above the floor). {床上浸水|ゆかうえしんすい} is the more severe category: water enters the living space itself, typically ruining tatami, flooring, furniture, appliances, and electrical outlets. Recovery usually requires much more extensive cleaning, replacement, and repair than {床下浸水|ゆかしたしんすい} and often triggers larger insurance payouts and government disaster aid.

Like {床下浸水|ゆかしたしんすい}, this word can be used both as a noun and with する ({床上浸水|ゆかうえしんすい}する: 'to be flooded above floor level').

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {床上浸水|ゆかうえしんすい}する: to suffer above-floor flooding
- {床上浸水|ゆかうえしんすい}の{被害|ひがい}: above-floor flood damage
- {床上浸水|ゆかうえしんすい}{○{○軒|けん}}: N homes affected by above-floor flooding
- {床上浸水|ゆかうえしんすい}の{恐|おそ}れ: risk of above-floor flooding

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {床下浸水|ゆかしたしんすい}: below-floor flooding — the less severe category, where water stays under the floor
- {浸水|しんすい}: flooding; water intrusion — the general term covering both categories
- {冠水|かんすう}: submergence (of roads, fields) — used more for areas than specific buildings
- {水害|すいがい}: flood disaster — the broad term for damage caused by water
